title: Rokko Ca$h - Smoked Away the Afternoon
htmlContent:
Rokko Ca$h's "Smoked Away the Afternoon" is that real deal Hip Hop that always stands out as elite. He brings everything together to make one undeniable sound, that goes beyond the subjectivity of music. He brings an authentic approach with the perfect blend of a golden age feel in the rhyming, to make a work of art for the culture to thrive.
